title: Timeout Race
prompt: Write `async function withDeadline(task, ms, onTimeout)` where `task` is a promise. If `task` fulfills within `ms`, RETURN its value. Otherwise RETURN the result of calling `onTimeout()`. The underlying task is NOT cancelled (that comes later) — you simply stop waiting.

tests.name: fast task resolves with its value
tests.hint: Promise.race([task, timer]) — the timer promise resolves after ms.

tests.name: slow task falls back
tests.hint: The timer promise resolves with onTimeout()'s result: new Promise((res) => setTimeout(() => res(onTimeout()), ms)).
